feedback: can you retain the exact type of visual 3d aesthetic, but convert the game visuals thematically to the sky?

selection.reason: Modifying renderGame is sufficient to completely reskin the 3D visuals and thematic text (e.g., Oxygen to Fuel, Submarine to Helicopter, Ocean to Sky) while keeping the underlying game logic and mechanics completely untouched.

patch.notes: Converted the deep-sea game theme into a sky theme by modifying colors, changing the ocean floor to grass, surface layer to high clouds, seaweeds to tall trees, background fishes to birds, bubbles to puffy clouds, divers to skydivers with parachute packs, enemies to planes and eagles, and the player submarine to a yellow airplane.
